d.title: Bakemonogatari Recap
d.synopsis: Koyomi Araragi started to be drawn to others with supernatural difficulties some time after his fateful encounter with a vampire. Reflecting on his first encounters with Hitagi Senjougahara and Mayoi Hachikuji, Araragi appreciates the journey he has taken to arrive where he is, and the relationships he has formed along the way.
